preparation_boundary.non_claim: This preparation contract defines machine-checkable shapes and fail-closed invariants only. It does not determine lawfulness, approve a purpose or legal basis, activate processing, authorize storage, or create a production release outcome.

purpose: Prepare a deterministic Protected Control Plane contract for future qualified-review-bound enforcement of special-category and otherwise protected data processing without treating governance intake evidence as runtime authority.
reference_resolution_rules: Every EvidenceRef resolves by evidence_id and evidence_version to privacy-evidence-record-v1 and must match evidence_digest and authenticated scope.

Every ApprovalEvidenceRef resolves by approval_id to privacy-approval-record-v1 and must match approval_digest, policy_digest, evidence manifest, authenticated scope, qualified role, validity, decision status, and independence evidence.
Missing, stale, cross-scope, digest-mismatched, unqualified, non-independent, pending, revoked, expired, or conflicting resolved records block target ALLOW.
authoritative_writer: Protected Control Plane privacy transition gate
authorization_rule: Only ALLOW may be consumed by a protected mutation, but this preparation version cannot produce or authorize ALLOW because runtime_enabled and allow_authorized are false.
evaluation_order: resolve authenticated actor and Tenant Area Project Session scope
validate protected storage metadata and immutable references
load the exact active policy and rule-set versions
validate data-class, purpose, activity, jurisdiction, retention, and protection bindings
validate every required evidence or qualified-not-applicable resolution
validate owner, privacy, legal when required, and independent review evidence
evaluate expiry, suspension, revocation, supersession, and conflicts
record the immutable decision and reason codes
commit protected mutation, metadata binding, receipt, and redacted audit atomically

data_minimization.allowed_evidence_material: opaque identifiers, immutable versions, digests, category labels, provenance references, validity facts, review facts, and reason codes only

authorization_dependencies: qualified legal review where required by the accepted rule set
